# StockUp

> A free Australian mobile app that compares grocery prices across Coles and
> Woolworths. StockUp tracks 30,000+ products at both supermarkets and refreshes
> every price weekly, so shoppers can see the gap between the two chains, catch
> specials, shop the aisle with live store prices, and send their list to
> whichever trolley is cheaper.

StockUp is published by SpendWise Apps and is available on iOS and Android. It
is an independent product and is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
sponsored by Coles or Woolworths**.

## Free features

No sign-up is required - the app opens straight into price comparison.

- **Side-by-side price comparison** - every tracked product shows the Coles
  price and the Woolworths price together, with per-unit pricing so different
  pack sizes are comparable.
- **Specials and half-price browsing** - search the full catalogue or browse by
  category to find what is currently discounted at either chain.
- **Shopping lists split by store** - build a list and StockUp shows which
  items are cheaper where, so a shop can be split or sent to whichever store is
  cheaper overall.
- **Watchlist and price-drop alerts** - follow products and get notified when
  they go on special.
- **Barcode scanning** - scan a product in store to pull up both prices.
- **Recent price history** - the last 30 days on any product.

## StockUp Premium

- **Smart Shop** - for shopping in person. Pick the retailer and the specific
  store you are standing in, and StockUp pulls that store's live prices and
  stock availability, then turns your list into a checklist you tick off as you
  go. Finishing a shop saves it to Past Purchases. Live prices and stock are
  indicative and come from the retailer's own systems, not the physical shelf.
- **Quick Cart** - sends your list to your real Coles or Woolworths trolley.
  You sign in to the retailer on your own device, inside an in-app browser;
  StockUp never sees your password and never places the order. You review and
  check out yourself.
- **Price Intelligence** - how often a product goes on sale and the typical
  discount, plus a buy-now-or-wait read on whether to purchase today.
- **Full price history** - the complete series, not just the last 30 days.
- **Past Purchases** - a ledger of completed shops and what they saved.
- **Ad-free** - no advertising anywhere in the app.

## Where the prices come from

Prices are collected independently from publicly available Coles and Woolworths
data. Updates run weekly, in step with the supermarkets' Wednesday catalogue
cycle - which is when specials change. Prices are indicative and can vary by
store and by state; the retailer's own price at the register is authoritative.

## Pricing

Free to download and use. StockUp Premium is AUD $4.99 per month or AUD $39.99
per year. The free version is supported by advertising, which Premium removes.

## Coverage

Coles and Woolworths only. ALDI does not publish prices online and IGA pricing
varies store to store, so neither can be compared accurately.
